Cartesian coordinates and velocity projections const x = r * Math.cos(this.theta); const y = r * Math.sin(this.theta); const vr = Math.sqrt(mu / p) * this.e * Math.sin(this.theta); const vth = Math.sqrt(mu / p) * (1 + this.e * Math.cos(this.theta)); const vx = vr * Math.cos(this.theta) - vth * Math.sin(this.theta); const vy = vr * Math.sin(this.theta) + vth * Math.cos(this.theta); return { r, x, y, vx, vy, speed, theta: this.theta }; } }
